objective: Review Filamajig NFC M2 offline provider-backed identification for deterministic data integrity, provider boundaries, ranking and conflict behavior, provenance, Android packaging, and failure recovery.
owner_requirements: Use a merged local GTIN index from OFD, OpenPrintTag, and SpoolmanDB Community with provenance on every match
Prefer exact identifiers, fall back to structured fields and text, retain ambiguous candidates, and never silently merge conflicting rows
Operate offline on the Motorola Razr 2023
Build and refresh the bundled Community catalog deterministically
Preserve existing records and unrelated NFC behavior
change_summary: Expanded the core CatalogProvider contract with structured queries, match tiers, deterministic ranking, conflict annotations, and evidence
Added OFD, local, merged-GTIN, and SpoolmanDB Community adapters and wired normal and exact-identifier search through them
Added a deterministic SQLite plus FTS4 Community sidecar containing 53,355 records and 30,161 identifier associations, with manifest and retained MIT license
Added malformed and ambiguous identifier fixtures, asset integrity checks, coverage reporting, host tests, and a real-device provider test
Changed Room code generation from KAPT processor arguments to the Room Gradle plugin and KSP, eliminating the unrecognized processor-option warning

objective_evidence.host: Builder fixtures PASS; asset verification PASS with 53,355 records, 30,161 identifiers and four ambiguous fixture candidates; 97 Gradle tasks PASS for core tests, app unit tests, lint, app APK and Android-test APK; forced KSP run emits neither room.schemaLocation nor kapt.kotlin.generated warning
objective_evidence.device: Final app and test APKs installed only on motorola razr 2023; DeviceProviderAcceptanceTest PASS in 0.721 seconds; result records four ambiguous GTIN candidates, three Community SKU candidates, one structured text result, 619.35 ms initial setup plus lookup and 6.61 ms warm p95

known_limits: The Community source is a retained hash-pinned snapshot; this change does not fetch live upstream data
The 91.22 percent barcode miss figure measures missing valid GTINs within the retained Community rows, not camera performance or the full filament market
Timing excludes Compose rendering and has no predefined acceptance threshold
Provider results expose one canonical color even when an upstream record contains multiple colors
review_questions: Is any architecture, data-integrity, platform, packaging, provenance, ranking, ambiguity, or recovery defect release-blocking for M2?
Do the tests objectively cover malformed identifiers, ambiguous exact matches, conflict retention, deterministic output, corruption repair, and real-device execution?
sanitization: No credentials, environment values, user records, tag UIDs, device serials, network addresses, or private data are included.
